label: late copy-phase steps (recalling original token 5 or later)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (99.99% of activations, 100% of mass); never at the delimiter and essentially never in the original phase. Within the copy phase it is restricted to late recall positions: recall_idx >= 5 holds 96% of activations and 98% of mass (rate 26-38% at recall_idx 5-8 vs <2% at recall_idx <= 4), so it appears only in sequences with L >= 6. It is concentrated near the end of the sequence (to_go = 0 holds ~59% of mass). Which late steps fire is only weakly token-dependent: out_tok h/1/0 (~16% rate) and prev_tok s/v/x/c (~10%) raise the rate, but no token set gives good precision, so precision of the positional predicate is only ~0.30. Top activations often come at the final or next-to-final output step. Does not fire on original-phase inputs or early copy steps.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: s, v, c, x, w, t; least: <DEL>, h, k, 2) and the token being output (most: h, 1, 0, y, x, n; least: u, s, w, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=5, to_go=0, recall_idx=6.
